semantics.scope: Native authenticates current real scope and connector credentials/manage capability before its private control forwarding; Host bearer/Trace never grant it. Same Host-owned Rust worker owns auth actor and Gateway; no second Native auth worker. Provider operations must not require a paid-model call or fabricated Runtime generation.
semantics.asynchronous: begin/forget/probe return starting promptly, retaining their own immutable operation identities; OAuth metadata/DCR/callback and probe work runs in the owned actor without blocking the serial control pipe. auth_poll operationId refers to the original begin/forget/probe operation; polling never creates or extends it. auth_cancel may cancel pending auth/probe but replays existing succeeded/failed facts unchanged. For forget, cancellation only reads current facts because an issued Keyring delete is not rollbackable; Native marks forget/uninstall deletion non-cancellable. Credential removal requires explicit forget; cancel of completed login does not remove saved credentials.
semantics.credential: Access/refresh/API key/client secrets and complete token-bearing endpoint configuration remain within Connectors/Keyring. No plaintext fallback. Keyring alias excludes Native epoch/display revision; it includes stable scope, service, installation, credential generation and opaque credentialRef. No credential-bearing URL enters this wire, Host, Native or renderer. Non-OAuth setup uses a single-use owned loopback form with original expiry, strict origin/host/form nonce and no-store CSP; the private pipe returns only its transient non-secret locator. API header name/value are validated and saved using the fixed Codex KeyringStore; they never traverse the control pipe. Exact fixed MCP resource is the only destination and secret-bearing headers never follow redirects. Official Zerone manual (2026-05, page 13) requires api_key query authentication. The MCP client/control side always retains the credential-free fixed resource; only the private Connectors HTTP send adapter adds the Keyring key as the exact api_key query, after admission and one-shot validation. No redirect is followed; raw/encoded key values are guarded, and errors discard upstream URLs. This is not an arbitrary user-supplied credential-bearing endpoint.
semantics.qualification: Only the separately assembled tushare-daily-v1 profile can qualify exact upstream daily through the owned normalized TushareDailyArguments tool. Fresh initialize/tools/list must yield exactly one daily whose complete inputSchema digest equals tool_profile and whose source shape admits the two forwarded strings without requiring other arguments; any schema drift fails closed. Never infer qualification from names, annotations or OAuth success. The previous tushare-oauth-v1 profile remains OAuth/metadata-only; the other 253 discovered tools and other services are not exposed by that historical profile. Owner removed taobao-flash-sale-retail and doukou-doctor on 2026-10-08; catalog revision 5 contains 49 active services. Removed services are not installable, selectable or executable; historical display receipts remain readable. The independent generic-mcp-v1 profile is now Owner-approved: complete normally discovered input schemas are compiled locally, frozen and checked for each call; explicit Native Enable, selected exact refs and individual ask approval remain mandatory. This extends the previous single-service profile without changing its daily normalization or historical receipts. Other services require their applicable auth/transport adapter, not individual real acceptance calls. Agentic Engine uses the existing explicit Header credential adapter for the fixed reference HTTP resource. The official docs instruct users to export their own remote client configuration; no header name or Bearer prefix is inferred from mcp-token or the separate stdio API_TOKEN example. Saving configuration does not grant execution: ordinary complete discovery and per-call approval still apply. Current implementation scope is 49 services; only Tushare is live-tested. Catalog revision 6 adds nine cross-border services (58 total). Owner selected Shopify Global Catalog keyless public tools with the fixed documented UCP agent profile. Sorftime new use is exclusively generic-mcp-v1: fresh managed installation, credentials, enablement, selected refs and per-call ask decision. Legacy Sorftime environment credentials, schemas and approval receipts grant no market authority. After local generic-path validation, the legacy startup credential and dedicated execution producer are retired; historical display readers remain.
semantics.generation: The single actor maps stable owner/tenant plus Host instance/Native epoch and an exact SelectionRef to one immutable credentialRef and qualified profile. CredentialRef changes require a generation change and revocation, never replacement in the same generation. Authoritative same-generation revision refresh must fence the previous mapping; lowering revision or changing generation invalidates old mappings and live capabilities. Forget/disable/uninstall/revocation closes old admission before normal cleanup. A UI ready flag, prior OAuth status or persisted observation grants nothing.
semantics.lifecycle: Pending OAuth/probe operation deadlines do not exceed their original Native authority or 300s, and polling never extends them. Completed authenticated client/schema facts have owned resource lifetime, not a reusable execution grant and not an extension of the pending attempt. Fresh current authority only reads those still-live facts; failed/cancelled/expired operations cannot be revived. Backend closure, credential/generation/revision or authorization revision change, revocation and owner exit invalidate retained admission immediately. Every old turn/call keeps its original monotonic TTL without renewal. Cancellation/forget fences the actor before reply; late callback cannot save/revive credentials. EOF normally cancels and awaits owned callback/client cleanup, retaining STOP_PENDING if needed; no detach/force-kill/fallback/automatic auth restart.
semantics.admission: Probe observes current execution capability and may retain an owned authenticated client with its checked schema; it is not an Enable intention. OAuth auto-discovery and persisted receipts do not register or resurrect admission. A completed client/schema fact may remain live under the same owner/tenant, Host instance, Native epoch, authorization revision and exact installation/revision/generation/credentialRef. A fresh current Native scope may poll that same original operation to observe the retained client without network, a new probe or a new authorization attempt. Explicit Native desired Enable, current permissions, selection/grant and ask approval are still independently required for every prepare/new call. Expired current authority cannot execute; its replacement never renews any old turn or call. Owner exit, client closure, revoked authority or binding/credential changes invalidate the retained fact. Never reconstruct it from SQL/history.

tool_profile.schemaDigestEncoding: lowercase SHA-256 of pinned Rust serde_json::to_vec of the complete parsed upstream inputSchema; sorted object keys, preserve_order disabled; no stripped descriptions/defaults/constraints
tool_profile.resultPolicy: Normalized output is a closed object containing required rows: an array of zero or at most one closed public daily row. Every nonempty row must contain ts_code and trade_date matching the requested identity and a finite numeric close. Other resultNumericFields are optional but must be finite numbers when present; no null/string substitutes. Empty rows are a successful empty observation. An identity-only row is invalid market data and must produce a safe result error, never be silently changed to empty rows. Reject mismatched identity, extra rows or an unrecognized MCP envelope; do not forward upstream text, descriptions, metadata or unknown fields and do not retry tools/call.
tool_profile.approvalPolicy: Validate the generated normalized input, freeze both strings and their argsDigest, show instrument/date and read purpose in safe ReviewProjection, then require matching owner approve_once and native elicitation for this actual callRef. Consume once immediately before one upstream tools/call; no automatic retry even if the result is unknown.

google_remote_adapters.sourcePolicy: Owner authorized adapting reference implementation to Yijie. Use official Google remote MCP endpoints documented as of 2026-10-08 rather than deprecated/local token-file packages. No real Google calls are performed in acceptance.

maps.storage: Connectors owned keyring form; no renderer/Host credential fields

calendar.requires: Google Workspace Developer Preview enrollment, enabled Calendar/MCP APIs and pre-registered web OAuth application
calendar.clientConfig: Connectors Keyring only. First form offers explicit continuation to Google OAuth; never treat saved client settings as account authorization. Codex/rmcp owns PKCE/state/token refresh. Confidential client secret is supplied only to the fixed Google token URL. No DCR or token files.
calendar.scopePolicy: Read calendar list/events/free-busy by default; event modification scopes require explicit checkbox in private setup form. delete_event has no impact policy and remains denied.
